text: Zinc is a bluish white metal, brittle when cold, malleable between one hundred and one hundred and fifty degrees, so zinc sheet is rolled hot. Its most asked property: it dissolves in acids and in alkalis, both with hydrogen. In hydrochloric acid it gives zinc chloride. In hot sodium hydroxide it gives sodium zincate. Zinc is amphoteric.
